note: Public benchmark files the bench may download (BENCH_SPEC 4.6 and 14). Every file is pinned by URL (a fixed revision where the host has one), SHA-256 and size; `fetch` refuses any other bytes. Only this lock enters the repository: the data stays under tmp/memory-bench/datasets (git-ignored) or, for `storage: private`, under $MEMORY_BENCH_PRIVATE_ROOT/datasets outside the repository.
